messages:
jia: Heads-up: p95 jumped ~3x on the canary for model v2026-07 in us-central-1. Only on GPU pool a100-40, p50 looks fine. Spike happens during later decode tokens (after ~150 tokens). Should we pause canary?

owen: I saw this too. Kernel-selection is flipping a lot on those hosts — looks like the chooser oscillates between `int8_matmul` and `fp16_cutlass` mid-request. Batcher metrics show more single-batch decisions.

sam: Interesting — we changed tokenizer split rules in v2026-07 (shorter subtokenization for punctuation). Could increase unique prefixes and reduce KV reuse. KV hit rate in the canary window dropped ~15%.

natalie: Adding profiler snapshot I grabbed during the p95 incident:
```
Profiler top: select_kernel() hotpath  
  total calls: 1.1M 
  wall time: 78% select_kernel
  chosen: int8_matmul 62%, fp16_cutlass 33%, fallback 5%
KV stats (5m canary): hit_rate 0.52 (baseline 0.68)
Batcher: avg_batch_size down 18% (more small batches)
```

owen: That aligns — the batcher heuristic `dynamic-window` started preferring low-latency single-batch paths when seq len distribution shifted. Kernel chooser uses batch size+seqlen to pick kernels; flip introduces extra kernel launches + kernel-specific config overhead.

maria: Flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood/internal/flame/1951234567-v2026-07 (only visible internally). You can see spikes in `select_kernel` and `kernel_launch` at the same timestamps as p95.

deploy-bot: Canary v2026-07 -> started 1951234500, traffic ramp 5% -> 20% (eu/us).

sam: So two interacting changes: tokenizer increases prefix variety -> KV reuse down -> batcher sees smaller effective batches -> chooser flips kernels -> kernel launch overhead and cold paths -> p95 spike. That chain makes sense.

owen: Repro plan: 1) replay canary traffic against v2026-07 on a test a100-40 host with profiling; 2) force-choose kernel path (pin to `fp16_cutlass`) to measure effect; 3) generate distribution with old tokenizer to isolate KV effect. I can run 1+2 now.

jia: Please run it. Also pause canary traffic to avoid customer impact. I'll revert routing.

maria: Quick profiler-run results: when we pin to `fp16_cutlass`, p95 drops back near baseline but throughput slightly lower. When we pin to `int8_matmul`, p95 still high due to kernel launch churn for small batches.

natalie: So short-term mitigation: revert tokenizer change in v2026-07 or disable `dynamic-window` batcher heuristic. Medium-term: make chooser consider KV_hit_rate (or prefer kernels with better cold-launchs for small batches).

sam: I can prepare a small tokenization compatibility patch that preserves new tokenization semantics but groups some frequent punctuation into existing tokens to restore KV reuse.

owen: I'll open an internal perf ticket and attach traces + flamegraph. We should also add a metric for kernel-flips-per-request to alert on this class of regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic paused at 1951234675 by jia.

jia: Thanks. Action items: sam -> tokenizer patch PR draft today; owen -> perf ticket + forced-kernel experiment results; maria -> replay logs + KV hit diff; natalie -> rollback note for release notes. We'll reconvene in #eng-runtime in 2h. :thumbsup:
